categories.main_business_segments: DAIKI ALUMINIUM INDUSTRY CO., LTD. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sale of secondary aluminum alloy ingots. The group also engages in related businesses such as the production and repair of aluminum melting furnaces and the manufacturing of die-cast products through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced aluminum melting and refining technologies, focusing on recycling aluminum scrap into high-quality secondary alloys. It continuously develops new alloy materials, improves molten metal treatment, and enhances raw material pre-processing techniques. The group also develops compact melting/holding furnaces and automated pouring systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The main customers are in the automotive industry, which constitutes the majority of sales, with additional clients in sectors requiring die-cast aluminum products. The company also serves other manufacturing industries that utilize aluminum alloys, with a strong focus on supplying recycled materials for hybrid, electric, and fuel cell vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: DAIKI operates globally, with major production and sales bases in Japan, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, India, the Philippines, Vietnam, China, and the United States. Sales are concentrated in Japan and Asia, but the company also has a presence in Europe and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned midstream in the supply chain, processing aluminum scrap (upstream) into secondary aluminum alloys and supplying these materials to downstream manufacturers, primarily in the automotive and die-casting industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, DAIKI emphasizes 'Global & Green' (G&G), aiming for global expansion and environmental sustainability. R&D focuses on developing recycled alloys for next-generation vehicles, improving recycling systems, reducing CO2 emissions, and enhancing circular economy initiatives. The company also invests in human capital, safety, and diversity.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of secondary aluminum alloy ingots and related products. Additional income streams include the sale of die-cast products, aluminum scrap, and melting furnace equipment. Sales are typically made on a spot or contract basis to industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other major secondary aluminum alloy producers in Japan and Asia, such as UACJ and Ryobi. DAIKI is a leading player in the Japanese and Southeast Asian markets, with a strong reputation for quality, recycling expertise, and global supply capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 299.8 billion yen, with operating profit of 4.8 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 0.7 billion yen. The company has over 1,290 employees and a global asset base exceeding 163 billion yen. While sales have grown steadily, profitability has recently been pressured by raw material costs and overseas market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DAIKI differentiates itself through its advanced recycling technology, ability to supply high-quality secondary aluminum alloys tailored to customer needs, and strong commitment to environmental sustainability. The company emphasizes its role in supporting the circular economy and decarbonization, particularly for automotive manufacturers seeking eco-friendly materials.
